issue_title: [Bug] _ensure_parent_directory 检查所有父路径但不检查 path.parent 是否为文件，当 path 本身是目录时可能产生误导性错误
summary: Added explicit check for parent.exists() and not parent.is_dir() in _ensure_parent_directory function to provide clearer error messages when the immediate parent path is a file rather than relying solely on the ancestors loop.
